name: Miguasha National Park
description: Miguasha National Park sits on the southern coast of Quebec's Gaspé peninsula, where coastal cliffs hold fossils from about 370 million years ago, in the Devonian "Age of Fishes." Its rocks have yielded some of the best-preserved lobe-finned fishes ever found, close relatives of the ancestors of all four-legged land animals. It is a rare place to see a key step in evolution.
